text:
Rhea Singh: FYI AerisCare opened a dispute on renewal invoice 110402 — they see an HSM add-on charged twice and a platform promo credited twice.
Carlos Mendez: Can you paste the invoice snippet here?
Rhea Singh: Snip:
```
Invoice 110402
- Private deployment license: $50,000
- Platform fee: $9,500
- Platform promo credit: -$1,200
- Platform promo credit (duplicate): -$1,200
- HSM managed keys: $3,000
- HSM managed keys (duplicate): $3,000
- Support (Enterprise): $13,000
Total: $76,100
```
BillingBot: (automated) Received dispute for invoice 110402. Duplicate HSM line and duplicate platform credit detected caused by legacy memo merge. Case BLG-2026-901 opened. Recommended single consolidated credit note.
Carlos Mendez: Metering confirms one HSM event. Looks like migration script applied account-level adjustments twice. We should issue CN-6124 for net credit amount.
Revenue Ops - Tom: Approve issuing CN-6124 for $3,600 net credit (3,000 duplicate charge reversed minus extra 1,200 credit duplication = 1,800 net credit?) wait recalc please.
Rhea Singh: Quick math: duplicate HSM is +3,000 (customer should not pay it), duplicate promo is -1,200 (extra credit), net effect is +1,800 credit in favor of customer. So CN-6124 = $1,800.
BillingBot: (automated) CN-6124 queued for creation. Case BLG-2026-901 updated.
Legal - Nora: Confirm contract permits correction. Recommend wording for customer email: "We identified an internal billing duplication on your renewal and have issued a corrective credit note for $1,800. Attached: corrected invoice and credit note. If you prefer a refund rather than applying the credit to your next invoice, please let us know."
Carlos Mendez: I'll reissue corrected invoice PDF and attach CN. Rhea, can you confirm if customer wants credit vs cash?
Rhea Singh: Replied to ticket asking preference. Will update here when they respond. Holding off on ledger until customer confirms.
Revenue Ops - Tom: If customer requests a refund, route to finance payments with case BLG-2026-901 and tag "refund-approval". Otherwise apply CN to next invoice.
Rhea Singh: Customer prefers credit to next invoice. Proceed to apply CN-6124 and reissue invoice. Please close case after CN applied.
BillingBot: (automated) CN-6124 applied and corrected invoice 110402-REV1 issued. Case BLG-2026-901 resolved.
Carlos Mendez: Uploaded corrected invoice PDF and reconciliation note. Closing on our side.
Rhea Singh: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
